proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704(1)(a), no building may be constructed unless it has what minimum relationship to a public space, yard, or street?

options.text: It must front directly on a public street on its main facade only
It must adjoin or have direct access to a public space, yard, or street on at least one of its sides
It must adjoin a public space on at least two opposite sides
It must have frontage on a public street equal to at least half of its perimeter

proposed.rationale: Section 704(1)(a) is the basic location rule: no building shall be constructed unless it adjoins or has direct access to a public space, yard, or street on at least one of its sides. Direct frontage on a public street is not required; access through an easement or yard is sufficient.
proposed.explanation: This is the first filter for location questions under Section 704. Confirm the one-side access/frontage relationship before measuring openings, projections, or fire-resistance distances.
